decision_question: For AM-016 Hyundai Sonata 2018, does disclosing the same verified accident/salvage history in the opening seconds improve qualified-lead quality versus disclosing it later in the Reel?
hypothesis: Early transparent disclosure of the verified front-end salvage history will reduce low-fit curiosity and improve the share of inquiries that progress toward a useful sales conversation or appointment, even if raw reach or inquiry volume is lower.

evidence_basis.reference: Google Sheet `AM Motors — Справочник машин`, AM-016, verified 2026-08-31
evidence_basis.finding: AM-016 is currently confirmed in stock; vehicle identity, mileage, asking price, condition and front-end salvage history are recorded.
Repeated UAE dealer propositions use inspection, verification, transparency and history/condition proof as TRUST/LEAD mechanisms.
A current UAE 2018 Sonata marketplace cohort is observable, but price comparability is insufficient for a precise market-value claim; transparency timing remains a bounded test candidate.
The causal effect of early versus later history disclosure on qualified-lead quality for AM Motors is unknown and requires testing.

audience.buying_stage: Actively considering a used sedan and willing to inspect a repaired/imported vehicle if material history is disclosed clearly.
audience.need_or_job: Evaluate whether AM-016 is worth an in-person inspection/test drive without hiding the known accident-history risk.
audience.budget_or_payment_context: Cash-only dealership policy; finance and instalments are not offered.
audience.trust_or_risk_concern: Accident/salvage history, repair quality and whether the seller is transparent about material condition facts.
audience.geography_or_language: UAE, primarily Ajman/Dubai/Sharjah; language to be chosen by Content Analyst from current account evidence.
audience.inventory_fit: Exact vehicle AM-016 Hyundai Sonata 2018, currently confirmed in stock.

mechanism_to_test: Timing of the exact same verified accident/salvage-history disclosure: HISTORY_EARLY places it in the opening seconds; HISTORY_LATE places it later before the CTA. Both variants must disclose the same material fact clearly and must not alter the underlying factual claim.
commercial_path: Instagram Reel -> attributable DM/conversation -> qualified lead -> human-owned appointment/test drive -> sale outcome if it occurs.
primary_kpi: Qualified inquiries attributable to each variant, normalized by delivered impressions/reach where available.
secondary_kpis: Appointment/test-drive proposal rate among qualified inquiries
Appointment/test-drive set rate among qualified inquiries
Retention and completion as diagnostic content signals
guardrail_metrics: No variant may omit or soften the verified front-end salvage-history fact
No material difference in distribution settings, CTA destination or factual offer between arms
Track low-quality/irrelevant inquiries separately from qualified inquiries
baseline: No valid vehicle-specific qualified-lead baseline is attached. Analytics must establish the available account/paid baseline or explicitly register a direct arm-vs-arm comparison before launch.
success_threshold: PRE-LAUNCH BLOCKER: Analytics must define an executable threshold before approval. Directionally, HISTORY_EARLY must outperform HISTORY_LATE on qualified-inquiry efficiency without a material appointment-rate guardrail failure.
failure_threshold: PRE-LAUNCH BLOCKER: Analytics must define an executable failure threshold before approval. A valid test that shows worse qualified-inquiry efficiency with no compensating downstream quality gain should not be scaled.
minimum_sample: PRE-LAUNCH BLOCKER: Analytics must set a minimum delivered sample/qualified-inquiry requirement from current traffic and measurement capacity before launch.
test_window: PRE-LAUNCH BLOCKER: Analytics must set the observation window and decision date before launch.
variable_being_tested: Timing of verified accident/salvage-history disclosure in the Reel.
controlled_variables: Same overall format and approximate duration
Same offer: no finance, no unsupported discount or market-value claim
If paid: identical audience, budget, placements, optimization, start timing and pacing under a proper split-test setup
If organic-only: do not claim causal superiority from raw performance unless distribution comparability is defensible
execution_constraints: Human must approve the experiment before content production/publishing moves to APPROVED.
Human must approve any paid spend separately.
Customer replies remain human-controlled; Sales agent may prepare analysis/drafts only under current operating bounds.
Content Analyst must preserve the single tested variable and must not introduce a price-first versus history-first confound.
Analytics instrumentation, variant IDs and attribution must be ready before publication.
Physical filming is a human task.
attribution_method: Use immutable variant/ad/content IDs; preserve inquiry source and experiment_id through Sales funnel events. If paid, use platform split-test attribution rather than launch-time inference.

decision_rule.continue: Continue only while the preregistered minimum sample/window is incomplete and no guardrail is violated.
decision_rule.iterate: Iterate one material content variable only if lead-quality signal is promising but the downstream KPI misses or execution invalidates the test.
decision_rule.scale: Scale only if the preregistered success threshold is met, lead quality is commercially relevant, and no truth/appointment guardrail fails.
decision_rule.kill: Kill or park after a valid failure threshold, material truth/measurement invalidation, obsolete inventory, or evidence that the mechanism attracts poor-fit demand without downstream benefit.

learning_note: Registered as BACKLOG only. No publish/spend authorization. Price positioning is intentionally excluded until a separate pricing-evidence gate is sufficient.
